explainBack.question: If Coxon himself says Anthropic is not cutting corners right now, why does he think resigning and warning the public was necessary?
explainBack.answer: His concern is a feedback loop: when companies use today's AI to speed up building tomorrow's AI, development itself accelerates. Competitive pressure then shrinks the time available for safety research and public rulemaking, so a company that behaves carefully today could be forced into safety-versus-speed trade-offs later. He resigned to put that prediction on the record before the pressure arrives — but the sources give no timeline, speed or probability for the loop.
